summary: Iter189v — Guided Flow badge + timer + media + Android CTA fixes validated end-to-end. Backend: 27/27 pytest tests pass covering _parse_reps_time_to_seconds (14 param cases), _derive_logging_type reps-time-hint promotion (5 cases), _enrich_for_guided idempotent duration fills on main/warmup/cooldown (6 cases), the iter189v backfill script's _apply_to_row (Mongo-seeded doc), and existing iter189o/iter189s/iter189m regressions (47/47 pass). Frontend: verified via seeded Mongo doc + Playwright on 390×844 viewport. Workout Detail correctly reads 'Zone 2 Walk/Light Jog · 25 min · RPE 4'. Guided Flow WORK panel now reads 'Set 1 of 1 · 25 min' (NOT '25 reps') and the big autopilot timer starts at 25:00 counting down (captured mid-countdown at 24:54). Warm-up phase (5 min row) correctly starts the timer at 5:00 (captured at 4:57). Android sticky CTA (START WORKOUT + MARK DONE) sits above bottom safe-area — insets.bottom applied on the sticky bar. Media carousel gate is now relaxed (verified in code — approval blocks only on explicit draft/rejected/blocked); the seeded synthetic Zone 2 exercise has no exercise_id link so shows the silhouette fallback (expected — not a regression, would render library media for library-backed exercises). Backend contract for programme-import→_enrich_for_guided validated at the unit level; the seeded raw Mongo doc + backfill produces {logging_type:'timer', duration_sec:1500} as designed.
action_items: None blocking. Optional: add a testID='guided-work-timer' to the big autopilot timer <Text> in guided.tsx so future e2e tests can grab it directly instead of scraping page text (currently we assert via 'MM:SS' text-content regex).
Optional: add testID='workout-start-cta' to the START WORKOUT sticky Pressable in workout/[id]/index.tsx (there's a Pressable but no testID — we had to fall back to text=/START WORKOUT/i).
critical_code_review_comments: guided.tsx autopilotWorkSeconds: the timeLike compound check (timerLocked || isCardioExercise(ex) || repsLooksLikeTime) elegantly avoids the 600s clamp for any coach-set duration; ceiling max of 10800 (3h) is sensible. LGTM.

WorkoutMediaCarousel: relaxed gate is coherent with ExerciseThumbnail (renders unless explicitly blocked). Consider extracting the shared 'shouldShowMedia' predicate into a util so the two components can never drift again.

feature_coach_manual_workouts._enrich_for_guided now runs the reps-time parser on ALL sections including main. Idempotency test passes (existing duration_sec is preserved). Marks estimated fills with duration_sec_estimated:true / logging_type_estimated:true — good breadcrumb.

backfill_workout_durations_iter189v.py: idempotent, only patches when duration_sec is 0/missing AND reps parses as duration. Bulk_write is unordered — safe. Records duration_backfilled_at_iter189v ISO timestamp on the workout doc for auditability.
workout/[id]/index.tsx sticky bar paddingBottom uses (insets.bottom || 0) so iOS non-notched devices don't get double padding. Correct.

Seed cleaned up after UI tests (delete_many by id). Re-runnable — script deletes any prior doc with the same id before inserting.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Guided Flow entry is a 2-step modal: (1) tap START WORKOUT on detail, (2) select 'START GUIDED SESSION' + tap the modal's START WORKOUT. Guided route is /workout/{id}/guided. Autopilot vs manual choice is a second in-flow modal ('Track my lifts' vs 'Just flow'). Warm-up plays first — use SKIP WARM-UP or SKIP MOVE to advance to the main-section Zone 2 row where the 25:00 timer lives. WORK phase header reads 'Set 1 of 1 · 25 min' (Text meta line) and the big timer text is a single MM:SS Text node with no testID today.
rca_of_issue: Iter189v RCA (validated): (a) main-section imported cardio missed logging_type because library lookup returned no v2 row → _derive_logging_type now honours reps-time-hint / duration_sec on the exercise row itself. (b) autopilotWorkSeconds' ceiling was gated only on timerLocked (post-iter189s) → now widened to timerLocked || isCardioExercise(regex) || _repsLooksLikeTime, so a 1500s duration_sec passes through. (c) WorkoutMediaCarousel required approval='approved|Live' → now blocks only on explicit draft/rejected/blocked, matching ExerciseThumbnail. (d) Android sticky CTA lacked safe-area inset → paddingBottom now = theme.space.lg + insets.bottom. Backfill script has been run on preview DB and only the 9 'Child's pose 60s hold' workouts were affected (no lingering Zone 2 issue in preview data).
